pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-03.png with Read. It loaded and was legible: five panels on 2+2+1 rows, with page number 3 at the bottom. The order I read naturally, left to right and top to bottom: (1) top-left caption 'A later morning: patients can always check in at the front desk.', with grey boxes raman and meera below it. (2) Top-right caption 'Some check in ahead on the Welbuk Health app.', with priya. (3) Middle-left caption 'Ravi scans the QR code at the door.', with ravi. (4) Middle-right caption 'A short form on his own phone, shared with consent.', with ravi in a tall placeholder. (5) Bottom wide panel: caption 'Every check-in gets a slot on the screen.' first, then the teal sign 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12' at the right, with raman, priya and ravi in a row below. There are no speech balloons. The page is all narration with no spoken lines.
pages.observation: I found no balloon-order problems. The panel order is clear and every caption sits at the top-left of its panel. Concrete issues: (a) 'A later morning' is a relative time jump with nothing on this page to anchor it. Later than what, and how long after the previous page? Whether it works depends on page 02. (b) P1 shows raman and meera with no cue to who is the patient and who is front-desk staff. In P5 raman gets a screen slot, which suggests he is a patient, but nothing names him or shows him using the desk. Meera's role is unexplained. (c) There seem to be three check-in routes: front desk, app ahead of time, and QR at the door. It is unclear whether the QR scan opens the same Welbuk app or a separate web form, so 'ahead' versus 'at the door' may read as a contradiction. Priya in P2 is not named in the caption, so the reader has to guess that she is the app user. (d) In P5 the slot labels A-10/A-11/A-12 are not tied to the three people. The sign is spatially separate from the faces, and the reader cannot tell who has which slot until page 04 says 'his slot' is A-12. (e) The P1 caption box ends just above raman's face box and nearly touches it. It does not cover it, but the gap is tight. The P4 caption is close to the tall ravi placeholder but does not overlap it. (f) Five panels of narration only, with no reaction or dialogue, make the page read like a procedure list. A small reaction or spoken line would help the pacing. This is a suggestion, not a blocker. Unresolved for the comparison stage: items (a), (b), (c) and (d).
